description: This file defines the implementation of the TpmAuth class, which manages multiple authorization handles (auth1, auth2, auth3) for TPM (Trusted Platform Module) interactions within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes constructors for initializing the class with different combinations of authorization handles and provides accessor methods for each handle.

classes.name: TpmAuth
classes.description: A class that manages multiple TPM authorization handles, providing constructors for flexible initialization and accessor methods for each handle.

methods.name: TpmAuth(ESYS_TR auth)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with a single authorization handle, defaulting the others to none.

methods.name: TpmAuth(ESYS_TR auth1, ESYS_TR auth2)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with two authorization handles, defaulting the third to none.

methods.name: TpmAuth(ESYS_TR auth1, ESYS_TR auth2, ESYS_TR auth3)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with three authorization handles, swapping them if necessary to ensure proper order.
